initial_query: When FOO is set, command-line values supplied to an optional variadic argument are ignored. For example, with FOO="env-a env-b", running the command with a b should return ("a", "b"), but does not. Please fix this while keeping environment-only and configured fallback behavior working.
failure_symptom: With FOO set, `cmd a b` returns env/default/empty instead of ('a','b'); env-only still appears correct.
expected_sop: Enumerate command line/env/default sources → inspect central consume path → restore precedence → verify source matrix.

feedback_by_state.primary: With FOO set, the explicit a b values still do not win.
feedback_by_state.edge: Please also check an absent or empty FOO and configured fallback values.
feedback_by_state.exception: The reported origin of the resulting argument value is still incorrect.
feedback_by_state.regression: A normal single-value argument no longer behaves correctly.

success_condition: All subgraders pass; infrastructure errors never count as PASS.
review_reason: Retained source-precedence design; scope mutation to nargs=-1 and preserve UNSET fallback. Add default_map and source provenance checks.

source_candidate.User Query Draft: When FOO is set in the environment, explicitly provided command-line values for a variadic argument are ignored. Explicit CLI input should win over the environment, while env/default behavior must still work when CLI input is absent. Please locate and fix the regression.
source_candidate.Damage Mutation: Move or bias envvar resolution ahead of explicit command-line values for variadic inputs.
source_candidate.Failure Symptom: With FOO set, `cmd a b` returns env/default/empty instead of ('a','b'); env-only still appears correct.
source_candidate.Expected SOP: Enumerate command line/env/default sources → inspect central consume path → restore precedence → verify source matrix.
source_candidate.Key Discovery: The defect is in source selection order, not tuple parsing itself.
source_candidate.Grader Assertions: CLI-only uses CLI; env-only uses env; both uses CLI; default only uses default; parameter source is correct.
source_candidate.Why Skill Helps: Without the Skill the symptom looks like parser corruption; the useful shortcut is to inspect source precedence first.
